user.title: Maintenance Dashboard
user.description: Create a dedicated sidebar panel for home maintenance tasks.

data_integrity.title: Maintenance Dashboard data integrity problems
data_integrity.description: Maintenance Dashboard detected {errors} error(s) and {warnings} warning(s). Open the repair flow to create a safety backup and repair non-destructive issues.

migration_failed.title: Maintenance Dashboard storage migration failed
migration_failed.description: The storage migration could not be completed: {error}. Existing storage was left untouched.

notify_service_invalid.title: Maintenance Dashboard notify service is invalid
notify_service_invalid.description: The configured notify service `{service}` is not a valid `domain.service` target.

backup_storage_invalid.title: Maintenance Dashboard backups are invalid
backup_storage_invalid.description: {count} backup snapshot(s) contain invalid task or history data.

confirm.title: Repair Maintenance Dashboard data
confirm.description: A pinned safety backup is created first. Missing or duplicate record IDs are repaired, invalid values are normalized and records that cannot be repaired are moved to quarantine. No data is silently deleted.

trigger_type.task_warning: A maintenance task enters warning state

condition_type.any_critical: At least one maintenance task is critical or overdue
condition_type.category_has_due: A category has due maintenance tasks
condition_type.task_is_overdue: A specific maintenance task is overdue
